hero.sub: ZAYA links the shops, customers and families of your neighbourhood — so you can find what's in your area, sell smarter, and provide for the people you love.
hero.statusBuilt: Merchant tools, customer browse & order, and delivery with COD settlement — all built and in device testing.
hero.statusInPilot: Nothing yet — the merchant pilot is opening in Nifas Silk Lafto.
hero.statusPlanned: Barcode scanning, smart tools & voice, sorting by your location, the diaspora basket.

showcase.heading: Built with the shops that run the neighbourhood.
showcase.sub: From the corner mini-market to the supermarket — this is where ZAYA works.

solutions.heading: One platform that removes the everyday friction of local commerce.
solutions.sub: Real tools for real problems — on one labelling axis: Built — in device testing, In pilot, Live, Planned. Nothing is in pilot or live yet.

diaspora.heading: Provide for your family — real goods, not cash into the dark.
diaspora.sub: A trusted neighbourhood shop, delivered locally, with proof it arrived. Planned — none of it is built. ZAYA is not a money-transfer service.

pricing.heading: Simple plans. No hidden fees.
pricing.sub: Customers use ZAYA free. Merchants start free — forever.

contact.heading: Let's grow your shop together.
contact.sub: Call, message, email, or visit — we answer every message ourselves.
